name: sg-carpark-gateway
description: MCP gateway fronting the LTA DataMall Carpark Availability REST API with IAM inbound auth

mcp.instructions: Use this gateway to find real-time Singapore carpark lot availability. Call get_nearby_carparks with a WGS84 lat/lon, optional radius_km (default 1.0 km) and optional limit (default 5, max 20) to retrieve nearby carparks sorted by ascending distance.
